spans.s:
(I)--the son of the sage Atri and Ana- सूया and an अवतार् of विष्णु according to पौराणिकस्; brother of दुर्वास; by worshipping him, the Yadus, Haiha- yas, etc., got knowledge of yoga.
1: भा.

. ८२; IV. २८. ८९; वा. ७०. ७६-8.
He knew Hari yoga,
2: भा.

. ४५.
and followed Hari going to पृथु's sacrifice.
3: Ib. IV. १९. 6.
A Siddha;
4: Ib.

hands;
7: वा. ९४. १०-11; Vi. IV. ११. १२.
श्यामस्, Mudgalas, गविष्ठिअस् and others belong to this वम्श.
8: Ib. I. १०. 8.
--a son of प्रीता and Pulastya; an Agastya in previous birth. वा. २८. २२; Vi. I. १०. 9.
(I)--a Paulastya and one of the 7 sages of the स्वारोचिष epoch. Br. II. ३६. १८.
(II)--given by Manu to Ahi as son; see उत्तान- पाद. Br. II. ३६. ८५; III. ४७. ६५.
